name: lddelta
description: Shared libc SP4: with 100 bytes of the arena held after libc, a conf listing curses alone loads termlib first (the loader's absent-dependency path) and then curses, both 100 below the bases they were linked at; lddig checks both against the host's layout for that order, so curses's data imports from termlib are bound at a non-zero delta.  The host's layout (ld.digest.pad, fgx_lddigest --boot) has libc and libfgx, resident from boot (/etc/ld.so.conf), above the 100 bytes.  Control: lddig against ld.digest, the layout without the pad, reports `LDD FAIL libtermlib its row'.
